notes: Semantic case: the query names no bench, module, or number, so bm25 (which needs query term overlap) has nothing to key on and treats all 31 `bench_name  N ns/iter (+/- M)` rows as equally irrelevant; identifying the outlier requires comparing magnitudes across rows, not matching vocabulary. recency is also misled: the outlier sits roughly two thirds through the capture, well before the last several rows a recency-only policy would keep at a tight budget.
